camera.active_state.note: Active camera state getter; checks +0x88 != -1 then reads +0x118.

camera.fov_update.note: Camera field of view update; hooked to override the gameplay value.

chat.local.note: CGame.Chat(this, RefString *text, RefString *colourClass): puts a line in this client's chat only.

chat.raise_message.note: Builds and raises ChatMessageEvent: (game, int channel, RefString *from, RefString *text, RefString *colourClass). Every chat line the client shows passes through here; not calling the original swallows it.

chat.say.note: CGame.ChatPlayer(this, RefString *text): says it as the player, on the current channel.

chat.to_player.note: CGame.ChatMP(this, Man *recipient, RefString *text, RefString *colourClass): server side, to one player.

event.chatmessage_name_of.note: ChatMessageEvent vtable slot 2: writes the literal "ChatMessageEvent" into the out-parameter. How a hook names an event without a table of ids.

event.chatmessage_type_of.note: ChatMessageEvent vtable slot 1: writes &game::ChatMessageEvent::RTTI_Type_Descriptor into the out-parameter. 14 bytes, no side effects.

event.dispatch_to_script.note: Calls script CGame.OnEvent(type, params). Reads the EventType from vtable slot 1 of the event; returns 1 when script handled it, which skips event.engine_default. Hook point for listening to and swallowing events.

event.engine_default.note: The engine's own handling of an event script did not take.

patterns: 48 8B 05 09 90 E1 00 C3 CC CC CC CC
event.manager.note: Returns the event manager both inspected event raisers hand their event to.

event.raise.note: Raise one event: (manager, &event). Sees every event, including those that never reach script.

event.raise_connection_close.note: Builds and raises MPConnectionCloseEvent, the kick and disconnect event, through event.raise.

event.register_type_ids.note: Assigns every XEventTypeID script global the address of that event class's RTTI type descriptor. EventType is a type pointer, not a number.

event.script_marshaller.note: Third referrer of the "OnEvent" string, 4936 bytes, unread. The likeliest home of the per-event-class conversion from a native event to script's Param; reading it is what unblocks reading an event's contents from a hook.

gui.hud_layout.note: GetHudContentRect; hooked to read the HUD content rectangle.

gui.input_handler.note: Window message handler and WM_INPUT consumer.

gui.inventory_preview_call.note: Call site of the inventory item preview preparation.

patterns: 48 8B 05 21 49 AD 00 C3 CC CC CC CC
input.action_registry_get.note: Returns the action registry: reads the input.action_registry global. What the by-id getters call before indexing registry+0x98.

input.axis_pair.note: Input interface slot 22: (mode, idA, idB, check_focus) -> (value(idA) - value(idB)) through a response curve and the sensitivity for mode (0 mouse, 1 raw, 2 mouse without the curve constant, 3 alternative), clamped. The aim consumer calls it with mode 0, so its result is an angular rate in radians per second.

input.click_by_id.note: Input interface slot 18: click, state block flag bit 21, by action id.

input.device_update.note: Raw mouse device update; copies and zeroes the accumulated frame delta.

input.double_click_by_id.note: Input interface slot 15: double click, state block flag bit 6, by action id.

input.double_click_by_record.note: Input interface slot 17: double click, state block flag bit 6, by record.

input.has_game_focus.note: HasGameFocus(id); false while the focus counter is zero.

input.hold_begin_by_id.note: Input interface slot 12: hold begin, state block flag bit 4, by action id.

input.hold_begin_by_record.note: Input interface slot 14: hold begin, state block flag bit 4, by record.

input.hold_by_id.note: Input interface slot 9: hold, state block flag bit 3, by action id.

input.hold_by_record.note: Input interface slot 11: hold, state block flag bit 3, by record.

input.interface_for_player.note: Resolves the input interface a consumer reads from. Returns Input+0x28 for the local player; a replay source or the remote player's interface otherwise.

input.keyboard_poll.note: Polled keyboard module; maps 256 virtual key slots through a table at Input+0x85D0.

input.local_value.note: LocalValue of a state block: the sum of the two floats at block+0x0C and block+0x10.

input.player_controller_aim.note: DayZPlayerInputController slot 7: aim. Calls the axis pair with mode 0 for (UAAimRight, UAAimLeft) and (UAAimDown, UAAimUp), clamps and multiplies by dt, which GetAimChange reports in radians.

input.player_controller_update.note: DayZPlayerInputController slot 6: the per-frame on-foot update (self, player, dt). Builds movement from the UAMoveRight/Left/Forward/Back values, so this is the function that proves the engine consumes analogue action values. The vehicle (UACar*) consumer has not been found yet.

input.press_by_id.note: Input interface slot 3: press, state block flag bit 1, by action id.

input.press_by_record.note: Input interface slot 5: press, state block flag bit 1, by record.

input.record_ctor.note: UAInput record constructor; sets the active state block and the record flags.

input.register_raw_devices.note: One of the RegisterRawInputDevices call sites.

input.release_by_id.note: Input interface slot 6: release, state block flag bit 2, by action id.

input.release_by_record.note: Input interface slot 8: release, state block flag bit 2, by record.

input.resolve_action_name.note: Resolves an action name to its record through the action registry. What input.value_by_name calls before the record variant.

input.value_by_id.note: Input interface slot 0: LocalValue as a float, by action id. Analogue: the on-foot consumer builds movement from these values, so an analogue value gives an analogue speed.

input.value_by_name.note: Input interface slot 1: LocalValue by action name; resolves the name through input.resolve_action_name and calls input.value_by_record.

input.value_by_record.note: Input interface slot 2: LocalValue as a float, by record. Checks record+0x74 != -0xFFFF, then sums the two floats in the active state block.

render.execute_view.note: Executes a view. Both call sites ignore the return value, so a view can be skipped for a frame.

render.frame.note: Per-frame work in world; builds the visibility and draw lists.

render.prepare_view.note: View setup; stores the prepared view pointer into the render context.

render.projection_dispatch.note: Per-frame dispatch; refreshes the primary FrameBase and the cached view and projection matrices.

render.world.note: Executes the prepared draw lists. Scene preparation, not this, is the per-eye unit.

rpc.dispatch_to_script.note: Calls script OnRPC(sender, target, rpc_type, ctx). Hook point for listening to incoming RPCs.

rpc.send.note: CGame.RPC(this, target, rpcType, params, guaranteed, recipient).

rpc.send_self.note: CGame.RPCSelf: delivered in this process only, never on the wire.

rpc.send_single.note: CGame.RPCSingleParam; same as rpc.send with one Param instead of an array.

script.call_method.note: Call a script method by id: (object, out, id, a, b, c, d). What the engine's own dispatchers use.

script.cfgmods_read.note: First of four references to the CfgMods config class name in the mod setup function; a fifth is at 0x5977EB.

script.cgame_registrator.note: Registers the CGame script class and binds every one of its natives as an ordinary member function pointer.

script.load_script_retail_gate.note: Loads the refusal message for ScriptModule.LoadScript on a retail client. The only reference to that string in the image, so the gate that blocks loading scripts from outside a PBO is in this function.

script.load_script_stub.note: Whole native body bound to ScriptModule.LoadScript on retail: log the refusal, return null. Registered as the static method at script.scriptmodule_registrator + 0xC4.

script.method_id.note: Resolve a method name on a script class to the id script.call_method takes.

script.module_config_add.note: Called once per CfgMods script module key with the key name in r9; the common path that turns a mod's config entry into a script module.

script.module_config_read.note: Reads the five CfgMods script module keys in order (engine, gameLib, game, world, mission at 0x4CA5FE, 0x4CA666, 0x4CA6C9, 0x4CA728, 0x4CA787) and calls script.module_config_add for each.

script.native_register_method.note: Binds one instance method: (class, ctx, name, function, flags).

script.native_register_static.note: Binds one static method; same shape as script.native_register_method.

script.scriptmodule_registrator.note: Registration of the ScriptModule script class and its methods: Call 0x31AAA0, CallFunction 0x31ACE0, CallFunctionParams 0x31AEF0, Release 0x2E7420, LoadScript 0x2D9A30.

session.connect.note: CGame.Connect(this, parent menu, RefString *address, int port, RefString *password).

session.host_address.note: CGame.GetHostAddress(this, out address, out port): which server this client is on.

session.is_multiplayer.note: CGame.IsMultiplayer(this). A cheap side-effect-free predicate, so also the way to test a candidate CGame pointer.

session.request_exit.note: CGame.RequestExit(this, int code): stores the code at this+0xD8 and sets the exit flag; the main loop stops at the next frame.
